title: The Silent Web Server
problem: Users report the website is down. Connection refused on port 80.

investigations.systemctl status nginx:
● nginx.service - A high performance web server
   Active: inactive (dead)
investigations.curl localhost: curl: (7) Failed to connect to localhost port 80: Connection refused

resolution: Nginx service restored. Website is back online.
hints: Check if nginx is running with systemctl status.
Try starting the service.

title: Project Setup: Initialization
problem: New requirement: Create a fresh project for the 'ACE-Labs' initiative. The project ID must be 'ace-labs-99'.

investigations.gcloud projects list:
PROJECT_ID       NAME            PROJECT_NUMBER
shellcraft-prod  Prod Project    123456789012

hints: Use the gcloud command to create a new project.

title: Project Setup: API Enablement
problem: You need to use Compute Engine in the 'ace-labs-99' project, but the service is currently disabled. Enable it.

investigations.gcloud services list --enabled:
NAME                              TITLE
storage-api.googleapis.com        Google Cloud Storage JSON API

resolution: Compute Engine API is now enabled for the project.
hints: Use the 'gcloud services enable' command with the correct service name.

title: Project Setup: IAM Assignment
problem: Grant 'bob@example.com' the 'Viewer' role on the project to allow him to monitor resources.
resolution: IAM policy updated. Bob now has Viewer access.
hints: Use 'add-iam-policy-binding' with the project ID and member email.

title: Compute: Instance Creation
problem: Create a new VM instance named 'web-server-1' in zone 'us-central1-a' with machine type 'e2-micro'.
resolution: VM 'web-server-1' is now running in us-central1-a.
hints: Use 'gcloud compute instances create' and specify zone and machine-type.

title: Compute: Firewall Block
problem: The 'web-server-1' is running Nginx on port 80, but it is unreachable from the internet. Fix the firewall.

investigations.gcloud compute firewall-rules list:
NAME: allow-ssh, ALLOW: tcp:22
NAME: allow-icmp, ALLOW: icmp

resolution: Firewall rule created. Port 80 is now open.
hints: Create an ingress firewall rule for TCP port 80.

title: Compute: Reserve Static IP
problem: Reserve a static external IP address named 'web-static-ip' in the 'us-central1' region.
hints: Use 'gcloud compute addresses create'.

title: Compute: Lifecycle Management
problem: The instance 'web-server-1' needs maintenance. Stop it safely.
hints: Use the 'stop' action.

title: Storage: Bucket Creation
problem: Create a Cloud Storage bucket named 'ace-assets-bucket-unique-99' in the 'us-east1' region.
hints: Use 'gsutil mb' with the '-l' flag for location.

title: Storage: Uploading Data
problem: Upload the local file 'config.json' to the root of your new bucket.
hints: Use 'gsutil cp'.

title: Storage: Permission Denied
problem: A developer 'alice@example.com' is trying to download a file from the bucket but gets a 403 error. Grant her access.
hints: Use 'gsutil iam ch' to add the objectViewer role.

title: IAM: Service Account Missing
problem: A background worker app on a VM needs to access BigQuery. Create a service account 'bq-worker' for this purpose.
fix_commands: gcloud iam service-accounts create bq-worker --display-name='BigQuery Worker'
hints: Use 'gcloud iam service-accounts create'.

title: Deploy: Docker on VM
problem: Run a standard 'nginx' container on your local VM terminal and map host port 8080 to container port 80.
resolution: Nginx container is running and exposed on port 8080.
hints: Use 'docker run' with '-d' for detached and '-p' for port mapping.

title: IAM: Token Creation Denied
problem: A script needs to impersonate service account 'sa-1@project.iam.gserviceaccount.com'. Grant yourself the required role.
resolution: You now have the Service Account Token Creator role.
hints: Impersonation requires the 'serviceAccountTokenCreator' role on the target SA.

title: Debugging: API Not Enabled
problem: You tried to run `gcloud container clusters list` but got an error: 'Cloud Kubernetes Engine API has not been used...'. Fix it.
hints: The GKE service name is 'container.googleapis.com'.

title: Debugging: Quota Exceeded
problem: You are trying to scale your MIG but getting 'Quota exceeded for CPUS'. Check your current usage.
resolution: Quota information displayed. You need to request an increase for CPUS.
hints: Usage and quotas are found in project-info.

title: VPC: Create Custom Subnet
problem: In the 'default' network, create a custom subnet 'lab-subnet' in 'us-east4' with range '10.10.0.0/24'.
fix_commands: gcloud compute networks subnets create lab-subnet --network=default --region=us-east4 --range=10.10.0.0/24
hints: Use 'gcloud compute networks subnets create'.

title: Deploy: GKE Image Pull Error
problem: A pod is failing to start because it cannot pull the image. Check the pod events.

investigations.kubectl describe pod web-pod: Events: ... Failed to pull image 'nginx:latst': Error response from daemon: manifest for nginx:latst not found

resolution: Corrected the image tag from 'latst' to 'latest'. Pod is now running.
hints: The tag is misspelled in the investigations output.

title: Compute: Snapshot Boot Disk
problem: Back up the boot disk of 'web-server-1' by creating a snapshot named 'web-server-backup-v1'.
hints: Use 'gcloud compute disks snapshot'.

title: VPC: Static IP Conflict
problem: You need to delete the unused static IP 'old-static-ip' to stop incurring charges.

investigations.gcloud compute addresses list: NAME: old-static-ip, STATUS: RESERVED, REGION: us-central1

hints: Use 'gcloud compute addresses delete'.

title: GCS: Lifecycle Policy
problem: Set a lifecycle policy for bucket 'ace-assets-bucket-unique-99' using the local file 'policy.json'.
resolution: Lifecycle policy applied to the bucket.
hints: Use 'gsutil lifecycle set'.
